title: Register Agent
description: Request and response (AgentManifest) for the `registerAgent` tool (spec section 4.3). Registration with the same AgentId MUST be idempotent.

request.description: Arguments for `registerAgent`; MUST be called before `step`

AgentType.description: Agent role; determines default scope and permitted action types

Config.description: Optional registration configuration; all fields optional except AvatarId when Scope is 'embodied'

Scope.description: Agency scope; defaults to the AgentType's default scope (spec section 4.1)

ClockMode.description: Requested clock mode; if ANY agent requests 'training', the environment uses lockstep simulation (spec section 2.4)

AvatarId.description: Entity ID for the agent's avatar; REQUIRED when Scope is 'embodied'

SpawnPoint.description: Named spawn location for embodied agents (e.g. 'tavern_entrance')

ObservationProfile.description: Named observation profile from the manifest (e.g. 'compact')

ActionMask.description: Allowed action type names; actions outside this set produce error -32001

Components.description: Reward component names (from manifest RewardComponents) to include in this agent's reward

Weights.description: Per-component weight multipliers, keyed by component name

Scope.description: Effective agency scope assigned to the agent

ObservationSpace.description: Observation space granted to this agent

ActionSpace.description: Action space granted to this agent

Sections.description: Named observation sections available via `observe(Include=[...])` (spec section 6.1)

items.description: One available action with parameter hints

Params.description: Parameter hints: parameter name to type-hint string (e.g. 'integer(0-4)', 'anchor', 'string?')
